# Vendored Auto-Editor

This directory contains the Python source of Auto-Editor 24.9.1 by WyattBlue, copied from the published Python package. The source is under the Unlicense; see `LICENSE` here. Upstream: https://github.com/WyattBlue/auto-editor

CutScript invokes this source directly during import. It does not require the `auto-editor` Python package to be installed. Runtime dependencies are `numpy`, `av` (provided through the project's transcription dependencies), and `ae-ffmpeg` 1.1.2. The local Windows environment was checked with `av` 18.1.0 and `ae-ffmpeg` 1.1.2.
